40019298.author: पदार्थः
40019298.content: ततः there upon, धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, एवम् in that way, वदताम् spoken, गिरः people, श्रुत्वा hearing, दुर्मनाः wailing, बाष्पपूरितलोचनः eyes dimmed with tears, मुहूर्तम् a moment, दध्यौ remained

40019298.author: Translation
40019298.content: Then righteous Rama, hearing the wailing of the people, whose eyes were dimmed with tears, remained for a moment.

40019299.author: पदार्थः
40019299.content: ततः then, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Vysravana, पितृभिःसह with father, यमश्च Yama, देवेशः Devas, सहस्राक्षश्च Indra of thousand eyes, जलेश्वरः god of waters, वरुणश्च Varuna, षडर्धनयनःsix eyed, श्रीमान् glorious, वृषध्वजःVrshadwaja, महादेवः MahaDeva, सर्वस्य all, लोकस्य worlds, कर्ता creator, ब्रह्मविदाम् creators, वरःforemost, ब्रह्मा Brahma, एते all those, सर्वे all, समागम्य reached, सूर्यसन्निभैः closely resembling the sun in radiance, विमानैः aerial car, लङ्कांनगरीम् to Lanka city, आगम्य having reached, राघवम् Raghava, अभिजग्मुः went towards

40019299.author: Translation
40019299.content: Then king Kubera, son of Vysravana, Yama, with Devas, Indra of thousand eyes, Varuna, the god of waters, glorious six eyed MahaDeva, who has bull on his banner, the creator of all the worlds, foremost of creators, Brahma, all of them reached Lanka city and went towards Raghava.

40019300.author: पदार्थः
40019300.content: ततः then, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Vysravana, पितृभिःसह with father, यमश्च Yama, देवेशः Devas, सहस्राक्षश्च Indra of thousand eyes, जलेश्वरः god of waters, वरुणश्च Varuna, षडर्धनयनःsix eyed, श्रीमान् glorious, वृषध्वजःVrshadwaja, महादेवः MahaDeva, सर्वस्य all, लोकस्य worlds, कर्ता creator, ब्रह्मविदाम् creators, वरःforemost, ब्रह्मा Brahma, एते all those, सर्वे all, समागम्य reached, सूर्यसन्निभैः closely resembling the sun in radiance, विमानैः aerial car, लङ्कांनगरीम् to Lanka city, आगम्य having reached, राघवम् Raghava, अभिजग्मुः went towards

40019300.author: Translation
40019300.content: Then king Kubera, son of Vysravana, Yama, with Devas, Indra of thousand eyes, Varuna, the god of waters, glorious six eyed MahaDeva, who has bull on his banner, the creator of all the worlds, foremost of creators, Brahma, all of them reached Lanka city and went towards Raghava.

40019301.author: पदार्थः
40019301.content: ततः then, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Vysravana, पितृभिःसह with father, यमश्च Yama, देवेशः Devas, सहस्राक्षश्च Indra of thousand eyes, जलेश्वरः god of waters, वरुणश्च Varuna, षडर्धनयनःsix eyed, श्रीमान् glorious, वृषध्वजःVrshadwaja, महादेवः MahaDeva, सर्वस्य all, लोकस्य worlds, कर्ता creator, ब्रह्मविदाम् creators, वरःforemost, ब्रह्मा Brahma, एते all those, सर्वे all, समागम्य reached, सूर्यसन्निभैः closely resembling the sun in radiance, विमानैः aerial car, लङ्कांनगरीम् to Lanka city, आगम्य having reached, राघवम् Raghava, अभिजग्मुः went towards

40019301.author: Translation
40019301.content: Then king Kubera, son of Vysravana, Yama, with Devas, Indra of thousand eyes, Varuna, the god of waters, glorious six eyed MahaDeva, who has bull on his banner, the creator of all the worlds, foremost of creators, Brahma, all of them reached Lanka city and went towards Raghava.

40019302.author: पदार्थः
40019302.content: ततः then, त्रिदशश्रेष्ठाः foremost of gods, सहस्ताभरणान् adorned with ornaments in hands, विपुलान् long, भुजान् shoulders, प्रगृह्य taking up, प्राञ्जलिम् greeted with both palms, स्थितम् stood, राघवम् Raghava, अब्रुवन् spoke as follows

40019302.author: Translation
40019302.content: Then foremost of gods adorned with ornaments in hands lifted up their long shoulders and greeted Raghava with joined palms and spoke as follows.

40019303.author: पदार्थः
40019303.content: सर्वस्य all sides, लोकस्य in the world, कर्ता creator, ज्ञानवताम् knowledgeable, श्रेष्ठः foremost, प्रभुः Lord, हव्यवाहने fire, पतन्तीम् falling, सीताम् Sita, कथम् how, उपेक्षसे looking, देवगणश्रेष्ठम् foremost of the hosts of Devas, आत्मानम् himself, कथम् how, नावबुद्ध्यसे not know?

40019303.author: Translation
40019303.content: "You are the creator of the entire world, knowledgeable and the foremost Lord of the host of gods. How did you keep watching Sita falling into fire'?

40019304.author: पदार्थः
40019304.content: पूर्वम् in the past, वसूनाम् Vasus, ऋतधामा Rtadhama, वसुः Vasu, त्रयाणामपि creator of the three worlds, लोकानाम् in the world, आदिकर्ता first creator, स्वयंप्रभुः Lord himself, प्रजापतिः selfconstituted ruler

40019304.author: Translation
40019304.content: " Among the Vasus, you are the Rtadhama and the creator of the three worlds and the first creator and selfconstituted ruler."

40019305.author: पदार्थः
40019305.content: रुद्राणाम् Rudra, अष्टम: eighth, रुद्रः Rudra, साध्यानाम् अपि among Sadhayas, पञ्चमः fifth, अश्विनौ twin Aswins, ते you, कर्णौ ears, सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ sun and moon are, दृशौ your eyes

40019305.author: Translation
40019305.content: "You are the eighth among the Rudras, fifth among the Sadhyas, two Aswins are your ears, and the sun and moon are your eyes."

40019306.author: पदार्थः
40019306.content: परन्तप tormentor of enemies, लोकानाम् in the world, आदौ at the beginning, अन्ते च and at the end, दृश्यसे seen, प्राकृतः common, मानुषोयथा like the man, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, उपेक्षसे च looking as if you are ignorant

40019306.author: Translation
40019306.content: "O Tormentor of enemies! You are at the beginning and at the end of the world. You are looking like a common man would look at Sita, when she was falling into pyre."

40019307.author: पदार्थः
40019307.content: लोकपालैः ruler of the world, इति this, उक्तः having said, लोकस्य world, स्वामी Lord, राघवः Raghava, धर्मभृताम् upholder of Dharma, वरः foremost, रामः Rama, त्रिदशश्रेष्ठान् supreme god, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019307.author: Translation
40019307.content: Rama the upholder of dharma and foremost and supreme god spoke after the ruler of the world had spoken to him.

40019308.author: पदार्थः
40019308.content: आत्मानम् I am, दशरथात्मजम् Dasharatha's son, मानुषम् human, रामम् Rama, मन्ये thinking, सः he, अहम् I, यस्य from where, अहम् I, यश्च whence, तत् that, भगवान् divine, मे me, ब्रवीतु tell

40019308.author: Translation
40019308.content: "I am Dasharatha's son, a human and thinking to be Rama. Tell me O divine creator, from where and whence I am here."

40019309.author: पदार्थः
40019309.content: इति thus, ब्रुवाणम् having said, काकुत्स्थम् Kakuthsa, ब्रह्मविदाम् creator, Brahma, वरः foremost, ब्रह्मा Brahma, अब्रवीत् said, सत्यपराक्रम truthful prowess, मे my, सत्यम् truth, वाक्यम् words, शृणु listen

40019309.author: Translation
40019309.content: To Kakuthsa who spoke that way, creator Brahma replied, "O Lord of truthful prowess, listen to my true submission."

40019310.author: पदार्थः
40019310.content: भवान् yourself, देवः divine, श्रीमान् glorious, चक्रायुधः wielder of discus, प्रभुः Lord, नाराणयः Narayana, त्वम् you, एकशृङ्गः single tusk, वराहः boar, भूतभव्यसपत्नजित् knower of past and future

40019310.author: Translation
40019310.content: "You are the divine self, glorious Narayana himself, wielder of discus. You are having a single tusk and a divine boar, knower of past and present."

40019311.author: पदार्थः
40019311.content: अक्षरम् imperishable, मध्ये च in the midst, अन्ते च and end, सत्यं च truth, ब्रह्म Brahma, त्वम् you, लोकानाम् in the world, परः, धर्मः dharma, विष्वक्सेनः all pervading, चतुर्भुजः four shouldered

40019311.author: Translation
40019311.content: "You are the imperishable Brahma in the midst or end, abiding in truth. You are dharma, all pervading four shouldered Vishnu in the world."

40019312.author: पदार्थः
40019312.content: शार्ङ्गधन्वा wielder of Saranga bow, हृषीकेशः subduer of senses, पुरुषः man, पुरुषोत्तमः supreme person, अजितः never faced defeat, खङ्गभृत् wielder of sword, विष्णुः Vishnu, कृष्णश्चैव Krishna also, महाबलः mighty

40019312.author: Translation
40019312.content: "You are the wielder of Sarang bow, subduer of enemies, a supreme person, never faced defeat, wielder of sword, Vishnu, Krishna also and mighty."

40019313.author: पदार्थः
40019313.content: त्वम् you, सेनानीः commander of the army of gods (Karthikeya), ग्रामणीश्च head of village, त्वम् you, बुद्धिः intellect, त्वम् you, क्षमा forbearance, दमः sense control, त्वम् you, प्रभवः origin, अप्ययश्च and end, उपेन्द्रःVamana, मधुसूदनः destroyer of demon Madhu

40019313.author: Translation
40019313.content: "You are the Karthikeya, the commander of army, village headman. You are the intellect, forbearance. You are the origin and end also. You are Vamana and destroyer of demon Madhu."

40019314.author: पदार्थः
40019314.content: त्वम् you, इन्द्रकर्मा creator of Indra, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, पद्मनाभः Padmanabha, who has a lotus sprung from his navel, रणान्तकृत् who puts an end to combat, दिव्याः wonderful, महर्षयःgreat sage, त्वाम् you, शरण्यम् refuge, शरणम् of seekers, आहुः spoken of

40019314.author: Translation
40019314.content: "You are spoken of as the creator of Indra, Mahendra himself, Padmanabha, who puts an end to combat. You are a wonderful great sage and refuge of seekers."

40019315.author: पदार्थः
40019315.content: सहस्रशृङ्गः thousand branches, शतशीर्षः hundred divisions, महर्षभः great bull like, वेदात्मा self of Vedas, त्वम् you, त्रयाणाम् three, लोकानाम् in worlds, आदिकर्ता beginning, स्वयम्प्रभुः selfshining, सिद्धानाम् Siddhas, साध्यानामपि among the achievers, पूर्वजः born first, आश्रयः च protector, असि you are

40019315.author: Translation
40019315.content: "You are the self of Vedas with its thousand branches and hundred divisions. You are the beginning of the three worlds and end. You are the selfshining. You are the Siddha among the achievers and their refuge as well as their protector."

40019316.author: पदार्थः
40019316.content: सहस्रशृङ्गः thousand branches, शतशीर्षः hundred divisions, महर्षभः great bull like, वेदात्मा self of Vedas, त्वम् you, त्रयाणाम् three, लोकानाम् in worlds, आदिकर्ता beginning, स्वयम्प्रभुः selfshining, सिद्धानाम् Siddhas, साध्यानामपि among the achievers, पूर्वजः born first, आश्रयः च protector, असि you are

40019316.author: Translation
40019316.content: "You are the self of Vedas with its thousand branches and hundred divisions. You are the beginning of the three worlds and end. You are the selfshining. You are the Siddha among the achievers and their refuge as well as their protector."

40019317.author: पदार्थः
40019317.content: त्वम् you are, यज्ञः sacrificial ritual, त्वम् you are, वषटकारः Vasat, त्वम् you are, ओङ्कारः syllable OM, परात् higher, परः highest, ते you, प्रभवम् origin, निधनंचापि nor end, नोविदुः not know, भवान् you, कःइति who you are

40019317.author: Translation
40019317.content: "You are the form of sacrifice ritual you are worshipped by Vasat. You are the syllable OM. Only the highest of the higher know you. You are without a beginning or end. Who you are is not known to Vedas also?"

40019318.author: पदार्थः
40019318.content: सर्वभूतेषु in all beings, गोषु च cows, ब्राह्मणेषु च Brahmanas, सर्वासु all, दिक्षु quarters, गगने sky, पर्वतेषु in mountains, नदीषु च in rivers, दृश्यसे see you

40019318.author: Translation
40019318.content: "You are seen in cows and brahmanas. You exist in all quarters, in the sky, mountains and rivers."

40019319.author: पदार्थः
40019319.content: सहस्रचरणः endowed with thousand feet, श्रीमान् glorious, शतशीर्षः hundred heads, सहस्रदृक् with thousand eyes, त्वम् you, भूतानि beings, सपर्वताम् all mountains, पृथिवीं earth च and, धारयसि sustain

40019319.author: Translation
40019319.content: "You are endowed with thousand feet, glorious, with hundred heads and hundred eyes, you sustain all beings, mountains and earth."

40019320.author: पदार्थः
40019320.content: राम Rama, पृथिव्याः on earth, अन्ते end, सलिले in waters, त्वम् you, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, देवगन्धर्वदानवान् Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas, धारयन् sustain, महोरगः great serpent, दृश्यसे seen

40019320.author: Translation
40019320.content: "Rama, at the dissolution of the earth you are seen to live on water and sustain a huge serpent. You are supporting the three worlds, the Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas."

40019321.author: पदार्थः
40019321.content: राम Rama, अहम् I, ते to you, हृदयम् heart, देवी Devi, सरस्वती Saraswathi, जिह्वा tongue, प्रभो Lord, देवाः god, सर्वगात्रेषु limbs, रोमाणि hair, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, निर्मिताः created

40019321.author: Translation
40019321.content: "Rama, all gods constitute your heart, Devi Saraswathi is your tongue, the gods created by Brahma are the hair on your limbs."

40019322.author: पदार्थः
40019322.content: ते your, निमेषः closing your eyelids, रात्रिः night, स्मृता death, तथा so also, उन्मेषः open the eyelids, दिवसः day, संस्काराः perfection in action, वेदाः Vedas, त्वयाविना without you, एतत् all this, नास्ति not there

40019322.author: Translation
40019322.content: "When you close your eyelids, it becomes night and when you open it becomes day. Your perfection in action are the Vedas. Without you, there is nothing."

40019323.author: पदार्थः
40019323.content: सर्वम् all, जगत् world, ते your, शरीरम् body, ते your, स्थैर्यम् firmness, वसुथातलम् the earth, कोपः anger, अग्निः fire, ते your, प्रसादः grace, सोमः nobility, श्रीवत्सलक्षणः sign of Srivatsa

40019323.author: Translation
40019323.content: "The total world represents your body, your firmness represents the earth, your anger is fire, your grace is nobility, a sign of Srivatsa."

40019324.author: पदार्थः
40019324.content: पुरा before, त्वया you, स्वैः, त्रिभिः three strides, विक्रमैः Vikrama, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, क्रान्ताः occupied, सुदारुणम् very dreadful, बलिम् King Bali बद्ध्वा binding, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, राजा king, कृतः did

40019324.author: Translation
40019324.content: "Before you took the form of Trivikrama, and took three strides, occupied the three worlds and bound the dreadful king Bali you made Mahendra as king of heaven."

40019325.author: पदार्थः
40019325.content: सीता Sita, लक्ष्मीः Lakshmi, भवान् you, देवः god, कृष्णःKrishna, प्रजापतिः Lord, विष्णुः Vishnu, रावणस्य Ravana's, वधार्थम् in order to put an end, इह here, मानुषम् mortal, तनुम् body, प्रविष्टः entered

40019325.author: Translation
40019325.content: "Sita is goddess Lakshmi while you are Vishnu. You are Krishna. You are the Lord of created beings. In order to put an end to Ravana, you entered the mortal body on earth."

40019326.author: पदार्थः
40019326.content: धर्मभृताम् upholder of dharma, वर supreme, राम Rama, तत् that purpose for which, इदम् this, नःकार्यम् that action, कृतम् is done, रावणः Ravana, निहतः killed, प्रहृष्टः happily, दिवम् abode, आक्रम return to

40019326.author: Translation
40019326.content: "Rama you are the supreme and upholder of dharma. The purpose for which you are born has been accomplished. Ravana is killed. You return to your abode happily."

40019327.author: पदार्थः
40019327.content: देव O God, ते your, वीर्यम् valour, अमोघम् wonderful, ते your, पराक्रमाः prowess, मोघाः astonishing, न never goes vain, रामदर्शनम् your sight, अमोघम् unfailing, तव your, संस्तवः praise, अमोघःwill never go in vain

40019327.author: Translation
40019327.content: "O God! Your valour is wonderful, your prowess never goes in vain. Your sight is a blessing, and your praise is unfailing and not gone in vain."

40019328.author: पदार्थः
40019328.content: भुवि in this world, तेभक्तिमन्तः whoever is devoted to you, नराः human, अमोघाः supreme, भविष्यन्ति will be very successful, ये they, देवम् god, ध्रुवम् firm, पुराणम् eternal, पुरुषोत्तमम् supreme human being, त्वाम् you, भक्ताः devotees, इहलोके in this world, परत्र च in other world, सदा always, कामाम् desired, प्राप्नुवन्ति will attain success.

40019328.author: Translation
40019328.content: "Those mortals who are devoted to you, the supreme god, will be very successful. You are eternal, supreme being. Your devotees in this world and other world will always attain the desired results."

40019329.author: पदार्थः
40019329.content: भुवि in this world, तेभक्तिमन्तः whoever is devoted to you, नराः human, अमोघाः supreme, भविष्यन्ति will be very successful, ये they, देवम् god, ध्रुवम् firm, पुराणम् eternal, पुरुषोत्तमम् supreme human being, त्वाम् you, भक्ताः devotees, इहलोके in this world, परत्र च in other world, सदा always, कामाम् desired, प्राप्नुवन्ति will attain success.

40019329.author: Translation
40019329.content: "Those mortals who are devoted to you, the supreme god, will be very successful. You are eternal, supreme being. Your devotees in this world and other world will always attain the desired results."
